role: Bounded laboratory chemistry support; not normative curriculum authority

references.title: University of Colorado E710
references.actualReadBoundary: Entire short E710 page, equations, additions and procedure; no silver/base-removal procedures adopted.
references.ownParaphrase: Adding iron(III) or thiocyanate to a dilute iron-thiocyanate system can increase red-complex formation. The new teaching material uses matched volumes/blanks and a single concentration variable. It is an authored qualitative adaptation, not a copied protocol or a full-speciation model.

references.title: Buffalo State Chemical Equilibrium Lab 4
references.actualReadBoundary: Whole introduction, procedure, calibration and working-solution sections.
references.ownParaphrase: Absorbance comparisons require consistent preparation and calibration. The author adapts this only as bounded optical controls, not its quantitative equilibrium-constant experiment.

references.title: OpenStax Chemistry, Galvanic Cells
references.actualReadBoundary: Primary educational galvanic-cell account supports separate half-cells, ionic connection, electronic path and polarity; supplied author voltages are synthetic and condition-specific.
references.ownParaphrase: A galvanic arrangement separates oxidation and reduction while retaining an ionic path and an electronic measurement connection. Meter polarity follows the chosen leads. The finite-resistance meter only approximates zero-current voltage.
